purpose: Apply an ESO-derived, four-port global calibration to a complete early B/R/I science triplet, using only global detector diagnostics and no member, candidate, cutout, lensing, halo, mass, current or gravity payload.

selection.bias_rule: Use all 14 V19AF bias records. They share the early four-port science signature and bracket the science night.
selection.flat_rule: Use all 25 V19AF four-port B_BESS/R_BESS/I_BESS twilight flats. Their gain metadata differ from the early science epoch, but scalar-normalized flat division is explicitly tested by per-filter leave-in residual and port-boundary gates.
selection.selection_boundary: The primary science triplet was selected from headers alone because it is the only temporally complete B/R/I set with one exact four-port signature. No pixel, source, photometry or lensing result contributed to selection.

decompression.persistence: Decompressed raw FITS files exist only inside one TemporaryDirectory and are removed when the run exits.

detector_model.correction: For each output and detector row, subtract the median of that output's 16-column prescan from its 1008 valid columns. Ignore the overscan, as specified by the ESO FORS pipeline manual. Concatenate only valid port regions into a 2016-by-2048 active mosaic; no read-direction flip is applied because the FIERA header positions the outputs in detector coordinates.
detector_model.bias_policy: Prescan-only correction is primary. Bias frames test whether any residual two-dimensional bias structure is too large; no two-dimensional master bias is subtracted, consistent with the FORS cookbook warning that it may add noise when structure is small.
detector_model.flat_policy: Prescan-correct every twilight flat, divide the whole valid mosaic by one global median, median-combine by filter, then renormalize the master flat to global median one. Do not normalize ports separately, so the master flat can correct relative port gain.
detector_model.science_policy: Prescan-correct and divide by the matching normalized master flat. Pixels outside the frozen valid flat range become NaN.

outputs.calibrated_products_policy: Persist compressed master-flat and calibrated-science FITS products only if every frozen calibration gate passes. Otherwise persist only the metrics report.

authoritative_references.use: Section 10.15: identify regions from ESO DET keywords, subtract prescan port-by-port and ignore overscan; Sections 11-12: create and subtract bias with propagated detector noise.
Section 5.2.1: prescan/overscan correction is adequate because FORS1 bias has little structure; a two-dimensional bias can add noise.
Four-port products require port-structure handling and trimming; twilight flats are the imaging flat-field calibration.
Old FORS1 four-port reductions can create port discontinuities, motivating the frozen boundary gates.

claim_boundary: V19AG can establish only whether this frozen archival triplet admits a defensible global detector calibration.
It does not establish astrometric registration, source detection, deblending, color calibration, cluster membership, stellar mass, baryonic current, lensing performance or gravity performance.
The compressed active mosaic removes non-science pre/overscan columns. Its inherited WCS is approximate and may not be used for astrometric claims before a separately frozen catalog solution.
A calibration failure is not a failure of Sigma Gravity; a pass only authorizes a separately frozen deblending protocol.
